exams.name: JEE (Main) 2027
exams.targetInstitutes: NITs, IIITs, DTU, NSUT, IIEST Shibpur, GFTIs

pattern.structure: 90 Questions (30 Phys, 30 Chem, 30 Math) - 75 questions to attempt
pattern.marking: +4 for correct answer, -1 for incorrect answer (both MCQs & NAT)

pattern.duration: 6 Hours (2 compulsory sessions: 9:00 AM–12:00 PM & 2:30 PM–5:30 PM)
pattern.structure: Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics (Single/Multi-correct, Numerical, Match List)
pattern.marking: Negative and partial marking as specified per section in question paper
pattern.boards: Qualified top ~2,50,000 JEE Main candidates + 75% in 12th board

exams.name: BITSAT 2027
exams.targetInstitutes: BITS Pilani, BITS Goa, BITS Hyderabad

milestones.resultDate: Instant preliminary score; Merit list July 03, 2027

pattern.structure: 130 Questions (Math: 40, Phys: 30, Chem: 30, Eng: 10, Logic: 20) + 12 Bonus Questions

pattern.boards: 75% aggregate in PCM with at least 60% in each individual subject
